## Summary

Adds a token-bucket rate limiter in front of every `/v1/public/*` route.
Limits are per API key, 100 requests a minute by default, and can be raised per plan in `config/limits.toml`.

## Changes

- a new `limit` module: the bucket, its Redis store and the middleware
- `429 Too Many Requests`, with a `Retry-After` header
- metrics: `api_rate_limited_total`, by route and by plan
  - exported on the existing `/metrics` endpoint
- `src/throttle.rs` is gone: the new module replaces it

## How to test
<!-- Commands a reviewer can paste. -->

```sh
cargo test -p api limit::
for i in $(seq 120); do
	curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:8080/v1/public/ping
done
```

## Checklist

- [x] Tests added
- [x] Docs updated
- [ ] Load-tested on staging

> Per-org limits are out of scope, see #415.

---

Closes #398. ![the rate-limit dashboard](https://github.com/acme/api/assets/1/rate-limit-dashboard.png)
